verdict.rationale: Docusaurus documents "first-class support" for Algolia DocSearch, and the service is free for developer documentation once you meet its checklist. That makes search available, but it relies on an external third-party service rather than working out of the box with no setup. Missing for 10: a built-in search that works with zero setup, documented typo tolerance, documented relevance ranking and speed, and independent hands-on corroboration of search quality.
